title: Durga
brief_description: Stone sculpture of Goddess Durga acquired from Vargini, Sanguem Taluka, Goa.
detailed_description: This sculpture depicts Goddess Durga, one of the principal deities of Hinduism and the embodiment of divine power and protection. Often portrayed with multiple arms holding various weapons, Durga symbolizes the victory of good over evil and the destruction of negative forces. Acquired from Vargini in Sanguem Taluka, Goa, this 10th Century C.E. sculpture reflects the artistic excellence of the Kadamba period and demonstrates the importance of Shakta worship in medieval Goa.
